tool.name: SMIS: Register Derived Version
tool.description: record what a step wrote into the research plane as a new dataset version, with lineage
tool.command: python '$__tool_directory__/register_derived_version.py' --dataset '$dataset_id' --source-version $source_version --objects '$objects' --kind '$kind' --identifiability '$identifiability' --actor-kind '$actor.actor_kind' #if $actor.actor_kind == "llm": --prompt-version '$actor.prompt_version' #end if --tool-name '$tool_name' --tool-version '$tool_version' #if $container_digest: --container-digest '$container_digest' #end if --research-source '$research_source' #if $title: --title '$title' #end if #if $description: --description '$description' #end if --parameters '$parameters' --galaxy-workdir '$__local_working_directory__' #if $__user__: --galaxy-user '$__user__.email' #end if $dry_run --out '$receipt'

param.name: dataset_id
param.label: Dataset
param.help: The SMIS dataset the step read, e.g. lung-mock-research

param.name: objects
param.label: Series the step wrote
param.help: One 'study_uid series_uid' per line, or a JSON list of {study_uid, series_uid}. The service reads them back from the research source.

param.name: identifiability
param.label: Identifiability of the outputs
param.help: design §1.5; aggregate and model are refused for per-subject objects (M103)

param.name: container_digest
param.label: Container digest (sha256:...)
param.help: without it the run cannot be matched to the image (M104 warning)

param.name: research_source
param.label: Research source the objects are on

param.name: parameters
param.label: Parameters (JSON object)
param.help: the declared inputs that changed the outcome

tool.help:
**What it does.** A step that wrote objects into the research plane (a segmentation, a dose calculation, a converter) is not finished until SMIS knows what it did. This step registers the next version of the dataset: the version the step read plus the series it wrote. The SMIS manifest service reads the series back from the research source and inventories them itself; the transformation record (kind, actor, tool, parameters, identifiability, and this Galaxy job and user) is attached, and the version's lineage reaches the clinical sources. A version without a record, a series that is not on the source, a series on a clinical source, or a class the content cannot have is refused, and the reason is in the receipt.
SMIS is research software and is not for clinical use.
